purpose: Results of 200 distinct targeted acquisition passes focused only on chronological injection-moulding evidence linking measured quality/defect deviation to an actual process adjustment and a verified recovery or confirmation outcome. Sources already represented through MM-DATA-184 were excluded. Closely related publications from the same research lineage are retained as source candidates but are not treated as independent production families without further provenance review.

searchAudit.focus: cycle_or_run -> measured quality/defect deviation -> actual corrective process action -> verified recovery/confirmation

sources.name: Shot-to-shot V/P and holding-pressure recovery after induced melt-temperature disturbance
sources.measuredContext: two-cavity tensile-specimen mould; tie-bar strain / clamping-force response; injection speed, V/P switchover, holding pressure and melt temperature
sources.disturbance: melt temperature changed to simulate environmental/process noise
sources.correctiveAction: shot-to-shot adjustment of V/P switchover point and holding pressure
sources.verifiedRecovery: part-weight consistency restored to a 0.01 g range within six shots; reported yield improved from 60% to 90%
sources.value: One of the closest independent matches to the target evidence chain because disturbance, corrective settings and recovery horizon are all experimentally reported.
sources.rights: publisher article located; reusable machine-readable cycle table not established
sources.nextAction: Request the ordered shot table preserving melt-temperature disturbance timing, V/P and holding-pressure commands, tie-bar/clamping-force features, cavity/part weights and acceptance status.

sources.name: LEGO multi-cavity dual-sourcing mass-feedback disturbance recovery
sources.measuredContext: 16-cavity mould; five ABS material grades/vendors; part mass and dimensions; holding-pressure manipulation
sources.disturbance: raw-material change introduced as both step and ramp changes
sources.correctiveAction: EWMA or gain-scheduled d-EWMA cycle-mass feedback adjusting holding-pressure reference
sources.verifiedRecovery: EWMA returned cycle mass to target within about 25 cycles; d-EWMA within about 10 cycles; later measurements showed about 50% lower mass difference and about 40% lower dimensional variance excluding outliers
sources.value: Strong real-material-change recovery evidence with explicit recovery horizons and physical dimensions, not just a sensor proxy.
sources.rights: open article; separate reusable chronological raw cycle table not located
sources.nextAction: Request cycle-by-cycle mass, material transition markers, holding-pressure commands and per-cavity physical dimensions for the step/ramp experiments.

sources.name: Adaptive startup tuning from defect acceptance feedback across machines and viscosities
sources.measuredContext: socket cover; hydraulic and electric injection-moulding machines; three material viscosities; vision inspection feedback
sources.correctiveAction: predictive delta-anchored or retrieval-grounded constrained parameter updates using qualification defect-parameter sensitivities
sources.verifiedRecovery: reported median runs-to-quality reduced by 88% and mean startup scrap reduced by 94% versus controlled baseline
sources.value: Directly targets production-startup recovery and cross-machine/material adaptation using observed defect acceptance.
sources.rights: publisher source located; reusable underlying run-by-run dataset not established
sources.nextAction: Request the ordered qualification/startup runs with defect labels, parameter deltas, machine identity, viscosity condition and first accepted-run marker.

sources.name: Multi-stage adaptive injection-moulding parameter adjustment with external sensors
sources.articleAccess: open access under a Creative Commons license
sources.measuredContext: tie-bar strain gauge and nozzle-pressure sensor; three-stage injection speeds, V/P switchover, holding pressure/time and clamping force
sources.correctiveAction: adaptive first-stage injection-speed and V/P adjustments from online quality indexes
sources.verifiedOutcome: multi-stage optimization improved product appearance defects and adaptive control reduced part-weight variation during continuous production
sources.dataAvailability: data will be made available on request
sources.value: High-priority request because the source explicitly offers data and contains both appearance-defect optimization and adaptive next-cycle adjustment.
sources.nextAction: Request the full chronological sensor/setting/part-weight/appearance-quality table and explicit action timestamps.

sources.name: Scientific-moulding adaptive process quality control with next-cycle corrections and beta-site validation
sources.measuredContext: nozzle-pressure characteristic values plus clamping-force difference; 120-cycle experiments and beta-site verification
sources.correctiveAction: if viscosity index or nozzle peak pressure exceeds limits, injection speed or V/P switchover is changed for the next cycle; clamping-force difference monitored to avoid flash
sources.verifiedOutcome: continuous-production weight stability improved; reported clamping-force difference remained near zero with no flash; beta-site verification repeated the control experiment in a different environment/material
sources.lineageNote: Same broad NCKU/Hwang adaptive-control research lineage as MM-DATA-188/190/196/198; do not count these as fully independent families without apparatus/date/material provenance.
sources.nextAction: Request cycle-level beta and primary-site tables and determine overlap with other NCKU adaptive-control experiments before independence scoring.

sources.name: Nozzle-pressure/clamping-force adaptive process control across three viscosities
sources.measuredContext: 100-cycle adaptive-control comparison; three materials of different viscosity; nozzle peak pressure, viscosity index and clamping-force difference
sources.correctiveAction: automatic V/P switchover changes in 0.1 mm steps and injection-speed changes in 1% steps when quality characteristics exceed control limits
sources.verifiedOutcome: reported product-weight variation reduced to approximately 0.106%, 0.092% and 0.079% for the three viscosity materials
sources.lineageNote: Related research lineage to MM-DATA-188/189/196/198; treat as a source, not automatically an independent family.
sources.nextAction: Request all 100-cycle setting/index/weight records and establish whether the cycles are distinct from later lineage publications.

sources.name: Direct part-weight feedback cascade control with cycle-to-cycle switchover correction
sources.measuredContext: part weight measured every cycle; multiple mould geometries and resins
sources.correctiveAction: cycle-to-cycle mass-based switchover adjustment plus within-cycle holding-pressure control
sources.verifiedOutcome: reported significant improvement in long- and short-term part-quality consistency and automatic process tuning
sources.rights: publisher article; raw experiment files/reuse permission not located
sources.nextAction: Contact authors/institution archive for original cycle-by-cycle part-weight, switchover, holding-pressure and mould/resin experiment files.

sources.name: Injection molding control: from process to quality doctoral experimental archive lead
sources.measuredContext: iterative learning control of injection velocity and melt-front profiling; online weight prediction and closed-loop weight control; experiments with different mould geometries
sources.verifiedOutcome: thesis reports successful experimental controller performance and robustness
sources.rights: institutional thesis record located; raw experimental files and reuse terms not established
sources.nextAction: Inspect thesis appendices/repository attachments and contact HKUST/author for original ordered experimental runs.

sources.name: Excessive-flash corrective DOE with zero-flash confirmation runs
sources.measuredContext: four-factor full-factorial injection-moulding experiment with duplicate measurements on excessive flash
sources.correctiveAction: recommended combination of pack pressure, injection speed and screw RPM after factorial analysis
sources.verifiedRecovery: confirmation runs produced consecutive parts with zero flash at the selected setting; article reports ten consecutive Bulldogs per confirmation setting
sources.value: Not a continuous industrial cycle history, but a clean defect -> parameter diagnosis -> corrective settings -> physical confirmation chain.
sources.nextAction: Extract only publisher-verifiable experimental tables under permitted use; request original run table if available.

sources.name: Factory short-shot corrective parameter optimization with large production validation
sources.baseline: January-December 2024 production: 19,957 short-shot defects among 1,674,504 parts (about 1.2%)
sources.correctiveAction: root-cause analysis plus process optimization; reported target settings include melt temperature 200 C, injection pressure 90 MPa and injection speed 70 mm/s with specified gate area
sources.verifiedRecovery: actual-production validation: 1,309 short-shot defects among 411,643 parts (about 0.32%)
sources.value: Strong real-factory before/after validation scale, but only aggregate production counts are currently available rather than ordered cycles/actions.
sources.nextAction: Request anonymized chronological production/parameter/short-shot records for baseline and validation periods under explicit reuse terms.

sources.name: Plastic injection-moulding process characterisation with verification shots and no short shots
sources.measuredContext: process-characterisation study predicting blade weight under selected process settings
sources.verifiedRecovery: five verification shots were run for selected settings; reported results stayed within 51-53 g customer specification and no short-shot defects occurred in verification runs
sources.rights: public institutional PDF; raw experiment table licence/reuse status requires review
sources.nextAction: Review institutional rights and request underlying experimental worksheet if preserved.

sources.name: Online quality-control system starting from non-appropriate parameters and self-adjusting next mould
sources.measuredContext: nozzle pressure and temperature sensing; BPNN; switchover position and injection-speed correction
sources.disturbanceOrStart: verification experiment intentionally began with non-appropriate parameters
sources.correctiveAction: system predicts next-mould outcome and adjusts parameters in real time when predicted quality is outside the standard range
sources.verifiedOutcome: reported part-weight variation reduced from about 0.25% to 0.14% and consistency maintained while the system operated autonomously
sources.lineageNote: Related NCKU/Hwang adaptive-control lineage; independence from MM-DATA-188/189/190/198 must be established.
sources.nextAction: Request verification-cycle data including the deliberately poor starting settings and each subsequent automated parameter action.

sources.name: Tie-bar elongation shot-by-shot V/P switchover quality control
sources.measuredContext: tie-bar/clamping-force increment profile correlated with cavity pressure and physical part weight; injection speed, V/P and holding pressure experiments
sources.correctiveAction: V/P switchover adjusted shot-by-shot to control peak clamping-force increment and maintain consistent part weight
sources.verifiedOutcome: article experimentally demonstrates the shot-by-shot control approach and part-quality prediction relationship
sources.lineageNote: Potential methodological ancestor of later NCKU adaptive-control publications; do not count as fully independent until apparatus/experiment overlap is mapped.
sources.nextAction: Request ordered shot-by-shot switchover, force/pressure and part-weight table; map overlap to later publications.

sources.name: Adaptive changeover-point control using viscosity-index feedback
sources.measuredContext: smart part-weight stability control using melt-pressure-derived viscosity index; changeover-position adjustment
sources.correctiveAction: adaptive changeover-position control in response to viscosity/material-property variation
sources.verifiedOutcome: published experiment reports enhanced molded-part weight stability under adaptive control
sources.rights: publisher article located; raw run table/reuse permission not established
sources.lineageNote: Same broad NCKU/Hwang adaptive-control lineage as MM-DATA-188/189/190/196/197.
sources.nextAction: Request raw chronological run data and determine whether this is a distinct experiment or precursor dataset reused in later publications.

truthBoundary: The 14 additions are research/source candidates, not 14 independent rights-executable production families. Several form a shared adaptive-control publication lineage, and none is promoted to canonical measured evidence by this manifest alone.
